paragraphs: Yitzchak son of Yonatan; Jerusalem Talmud Niddah, end of chapter 2. Rabbah son of Yonatan; Yoma 46a.[^1]

notes.text: ספ״ב gives end of chapter 2 in the Jerusalem Talmud Niddah reference. מו. gives Yoma 46a by the period convention, though the period may also be a terminal stop. Neither locator is independently checked against a named edition. Yitzchak and Rabbah remain separate patronymic attestations without establishing one father. None of the names has a separate title in this notice.
